title: Mega Menu Nav
description: Vertical fold-out nav used inside the mega menu and dropdown template parts. Row height comes from settings.custom.mega-menu.row-padding in theme.json, which the query column (styles/blocks/query/mega-menu-list.json) reads too — the two lists sit side by side and must share a rhythm, so the value is one place. Carries the resting appearance — vertical first column, label typography and the side-pointing caret. Rows carry no divider: a `border-bottom` hairline in neutral-300 sat on every `.wp-block-navigation-item` until 2026-09-18 and was removed on Zared's instruction — the row padding alone separates the labels, and the column hairlines in assets/styles/ollie-mega-menu.css are the only rules left in a panel. Its counterpart on the query-driven columns was changed with it and has to stay in step. Hover and :first-child reveal rules cannot live in this file's css field: WordPress wraps a block style's css in :root :where() (zero specificity, so it can't out-rank core's submenu positioning) and strips :hover / :first-child out of the css field entirely — put those in assets/styles/core-navigation.css. Its counterpart on the query-driven columns is styles/blocks/query/mega-menu-list.json — the same row on different markup, so the two have to be changed together.
